purpose: Detect platform server maintenance ('점검 중 입니다'), extract the specified maintenance window, pause publishing activities dynamically, and disarm false-positive Slack alarms.
design_intent: Transform unhandled HTTP 503 errors from critical system failures into structured operational pause events, preventing redundant browser runs and eliminating operator alert fatigue.

model_execution_guidance.note: Requires Korean natural language regex parsing, timezone normalization (KST to UTC), and timer state integration. Fast models (Gemini Flash High) should be batched: Batch 1 for regex parser + unit test suite; Batch 2 for scheduler pause integration + Slack alert logic.

work_items.title: Korean maintenance notice & schedule parser engine
work_items.action: Add isMaintenance, maintenanceNotice, and maintenanceUntil to BoardDiagnostics. Recognize HTTP 503/502/504 and Korean keywords ('점검 안내', '시스템 점검 중'). Implement regex extractor for datetime ranges ('2026년 8월 18일 21:00 ~ 23:00', '02:00 ~ 06:00') and convert to UTC resume time with +5m buffer. Fallback to 30m pause if time is unspecified.

work_items.title: Maintenance state tracking and persistence
work_items.action: Add maintenanceBlockedUntil to PublisherControls with serialization to runtime-controls.json.

work_items.title: Dynamic scheduler maintenance pause integration
work_items.action: When run decision is system_maintenance or maintenanceBlockedUntil is active, calculate remaining minutes and schedule the next tick directly to the resume timestamp. Skip all intermediate browser launches.

work_items.title: Informative Slack maintenance notifications
work_items.action: Dispatch an informative '🚧 Platform Maintenance Detected' notification containing the notice text and expected resumption time. Suppress repetitive failure alerts (❌) during the maintenance window.

gate_criteria: Unit tests for maintenance regex parsing pass with various Korean formats
Scheduler correctly pauses and sets nextTickEta to maintenance window end
npm run lint passes with 0 errors
npm run test:unit passes all tests

handover_instructions.continuation_prompt: Phase 3 (Maintenance Engine) is complete.
